rationale: Use public RawNode bootstrap, campaign, proposal, application and transfer APIs; no internal writes or fabricated peer responses. One FIFO transport serializes actual emitted messages and transiently drops MsgTimeoutNow through ten ticks. All persistence/apply/Advance work is processed synchronously, with transfer legally interposed between ApplyConfChange and Advance for the joint entry. A no-transfer control has identical configuration input. Selected private fields are read-only diagnostics to distinguish queue depletion from incomplete setup; no state-cycle claim is made. No crashes occur, so MemoryStorage completion substitutes for durable media. The driver stops after forty ticks plus independently scheduled diagnostic proposal, not upon failure to exit.
question: For candidate 8b412541680b42dd938dc9d5945e1aed, can actual three-node producers reach application-completion rejection during a transfer, then remain joint after transfer timeout while transport, required ticks and Ready handling continue? Does an independently scheduled later proposal restore exit? Finite checkpoints are construction observations, not a deadline oracle or proof of infinite stalling.
